# PixiJS 8.22.0

Pinned local browser build, loaded only when Sound Garden opens.
Source: https://github.com/pixijs/pixijs/releases/tag/v8.22.0
Build: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@8.22.0/dist/pixi.min.js
License: MIT, included in LICENSE.
Docs: https://pixijs.com/8.x/guides/components/application
Private ticker, WebGL preference, resolution capped at 2, 40 FPS cap. DOM controls preserve keyboard access. Texture ownership is limited to this game; shared images/audio are unchanged.
